blocks.text: Pode mukhtalif qism ki jagahon (habitats) mein milte hain: pani wali (aquatic), mo'tadil (moderate), bohat khushk (dry) zameen aur namkeen (saline). Isi liye unhen tarteeb se hydrophytes, mesophytes, xerophytes aur halophytes kehte hain.

Hydrophytes pani wale mahol, samundari (marine) aur meethe pani (freshwater) dono, mein rehne ke liye khaas osmotic tareeqon se dhal gaye hain. Samundari hydrophytes namkeen (hypertonic) pani mein achhi tarah ugte hain, jahan pani un ke cells se bahar nikalne ki koshish karta hai. Yeh zaid namak khaas salt glands se bahar nikalte hain aur proline, glycine betaine aur sugars jaise organic solutes banate hain, taake apna andaruni osmotic potential barha kar pani rok saken. In ki cuticles (patte par mom jaisi teh) moti hoti hain jo pani ka ziyan aur kam karti hain, aur yeh zyada namak bardasht karne wali halophytic khasoosiyat rakhte hain. Meethe pani ke hydrophytes hypotonic mahol mein ugte hain, jahan pani lagataar un ke cells mein aata rehta hai. Yeh pode zaid pani hydathodes (patton ke kinaron par pani nikalne wale surakh) ya vacuoles jaisi banawaton se bahar nikalte hain taake cells mein pani hadd se zyada na ho. Yeh potassium aur calcium jaise zaroori ions active transport se jazb karte hain taake patle (dilute) pani mein bhi osmotic tawazun qaim rahe. In ki cuticles patli hoti hain ya hoti hi nahin, is liye pani ka len den asaan rehta hai. In ki jarein aksar chhoti hoti hain, kyun ke yeh nutrients aur pani seedha apne gird ke pani se jazb kar lete hain. Hydrophytes ki misalein: water lily, kanwal (lotus), seaweeds aur tape grass.

blocks.alt: Do tasveerein saath saath. (a) Waterlily: gehre pani par saath saath tairte gol, kate hue (notched) patte, do khule safed phool aur safed kaliyan. (b) Tape grass: meethe pani ki jheel ki tah se neele-hare pani mein uthte lambe, feeta (ribbon) jaise hare patte.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.17: (a) Meethe pani mein tairti waterlily. (b) Meethe pani ki jheel mein tape grass (kitab ki Figure 8.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Mesophytes mo'tadil mahol mein rehte hain jo na zyada khushk ho na zyada geela. Yeh aisi mitti pasand karte hain jis mein pani khara na ho (not waterlogged) aur namak aur nami (humidity) darmiyani ho. Mesophytes ki jarein aur shoots achhi tarah bani hoti hain aur in ka vascular system mukammal hota hai. Inhen zinda rehne ke liye kisi khaas tabdeeli (adaptation) ki zaroorat nahin hoti. In ke patte chapte, chaure aur hare hote hain aur satah par stomata hote hain. Mesophytes ki misalein: gulab (rose), tamatar aur daisy.

blocks.alt: Do tasveerein saath saath. Baen: poora khila hua gulabi-surkh gulab (rose), peeche hari tehniyon par band surkh kaliyan. Daen: hari tehniyon ke beech peele darmiyan wale safed daisy phoolon ka khet.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.18: Mesophytes ki misalein, baen gulab (rose) aur daen daisy (kitab ki Figure 8.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Xerophytes woh pode hain jo khushk halaat mein zinda rehne ke liye dhal gaye hain. In mein pani ka ziyan kam karne aur pani zakheera karne ki khaas tabdeeliyan hoti hain. Pani zakheera karne wale podon ko succulents kehte hain. In ke gudedar (fleshy) tane pani jama rakhte hain jo zaroorat par istemal hota hai. Xerophytes ki doosri tabdeeliyan: patton par mom ki teh (waxy coating) taake pani kam ure, khushk mausam mein patte gira dena, aur patton ko mor lena ya un ka rukh badalna taake un par dhoop kam pare aur pani kam ure. Xerophytes ki misalein: kantedar darakht (thorn trees), desert marigold aur blue agave.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke xerophytes patte mor kar ya un ka rukh badal kar dhoop “behtar tareeqe se” lete hain. Asal mein patte morne ya un ka kinara sooraj ki taraf karne se patte par roshni aur garmi kam parti hai, is liye pani kam urta hai aur patta zyada garam nahi hota. Maqsad kam dhoop hai, zyada nahi.

blocks.alt: Neele aasman ke neeche registan. Baen taraf upar ko mure bazuon wala ek lamba cactus khara hai; peeche chapti choti wali narangi-surkh pathreeli pahari; aage registan ki chhoti jhaariyan aur chhote cactus.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.19: Ek xerophytic pauda (kitab ki Figure 8.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Halophytes namkeen mitti mein rehte hain jis mein NaCl, MgCl₂, MgSO₄ jaise namak zyada hon, ya namkeen pani mein. Aisi zameen par sirf wohi pode ug sakte hain jo in namkon ki kafi zyada concentration bardasht kar saken. In podon ke patte gudedar (succulent) hote hain aur kabhi kabhi tana bhi gudedar hota hai. Kuch podon mein patte kanton (spines) mein badal jate hain. Halophytes ki misalein: sea arrowgrass aur sea lavender.

blocks.alt: Keechar wale kinare par sea arrowgrass ka guchha: ek hi jagah se nikalte bohat se patle, ghaas jaise patte, aur seedhi patli phool wali dandiyan jin par chhote bhoore phool hain. Peeche pursukoon surmai-neela pani aur halke aasman ke neeche hare sarkandon (reeds) ka door ka kinara.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.20: Sea arrowgrass (kitab ki Figure 8.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Samundar ke kinare daldali (marshy) jagahon par ugne wale halophytes ek khaas qism ka jungle banate hain jise mangrove ya tidal woodland kehte hain. Inhen helophilous halophytes bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Meethe pani ka ek poda aur ek samundari seaweed, dono ko osmosis ka ek masla rehta hai. Har ek ka masla aur us ka ek hal (adaptation) batayein.
blocks.explanation: Meethe pani ka poda hypotonic pani mein hai, is liye pani us ke cells mein aata rehta hai; woh zaid pani hydathodes ya vacuoles se nikalta hai aur potassium aur calcium jaise ions jazb karta hai. Seaweed hypertonic samundari pani mein hai, is liye pani us ke cells se nikalna chahta hai; woh zaid namak salt glands se nikalta hai aur proline jaise organic solutes bana kar pani rokta hai.

items: Osmoregulation andar ke pani aur solutes ka tawazun rakhti hai. Hypotonic mahlool mein cell phoolta hai, hypertonic mein sukarta hai (plasmolysis), isotonic mein koi net harkat nahin.

Hydrophytes: samundari namak nikalte, organic solutes banate aur moti cuticle rakhte hain; meethe pani wale zaid pani nikalte, ions lete, patli cuticle aur chhoti jarein rakhte hain. Mesophytes ko khaas tabdeeli nahin chahiye. Xerophytes pani jama karte (succulents) aur mom, patte girane aur morne se pani bachate hain. Halophytes namkeen zameen mein gudedar patton aur tanon ke saath ugte hain; mangroves kinare ke halophytes hain.
